summary: The complete Indonesian target preserves the source mathematics, logic, topology, source structure, exercises, hints, and cross-references; applies all five reviewed source-correction treatments correctly; and now uses natural, internally consistent prefix notation for measurability relative to a sigma-algebra or pair of sigma-algebras. The bounded terminology correction and five polished sequence conclusions were read back against the authority, and no defect remains.

review_method.primary_method: Read every authority line and every target line in source order, checking proposition-by-proposition and clause-by-clause that the Indonesian text preserves the asserted objects, domains, hypotheses, quantifiers, inequalities, set operations, endpoint topology, conclusions, and proof dependencies.
review_method.correction_method: Replayed every item in qa/mt121-source-review.json against the exact target wording and formula at its final target location.
review_method.xref_method: Revalidated the 76 literal active printed source expressions at their authority locators, expanded the three printed ranges into 80 atomic targets, and replayed the 76 expressions in target order. The sole translated prose reference, Volume 2, is correctly rendered Jilid 2.
review_method.mechanical_cross_check: Reran scripts/qa_fremlin_unit.py without an output path against the frozen source and target and the six exact allowed math-delta ordinals. It exited zero: 1,853 commands, 1,851 symbolic commands, 23 stable IDs, 957 math segments, 92 generic protected-reference tokens, and one active Hint macro matched; the exact math-delta set matched and no active English residue was found.
review_method.judgment_boundary: The mechanical gate supports but does not replace the complete human semantic and language reread. After the initial language review found the bounded terminology-order defect, every corrected occurrence and every polished sequence conclusion was read back in context before the final pass was issued.

definition_bearing_surfaces_reviewed: 121Xe subspace topology and Borel subspace sigma-algebra

source_correction_treatments.treatment: The target explicitly pairs c in E with the right-closed interval D intersection ocint(-infinity,c), and c not in E with the open interval D intersection ooint(-infinity,c).
The concluding measurability assertion consistently uses liminf with n tending to infinity.
The summand is grouped as the sum of (absolute a_k plus absolute b_k), leaving no free k outside the summation scope.
Closure under complements is stated in the correct ambient space R^r, matching the current official source and errata.
The coordinate tuple begins with phi_1 and ends with phi_r.

resolved_defects.resolution: All reversed suffix surfaces were converted to the natural prefix forms Sigma-terukur, Tau-terukur, and (Sigma,Tau)-terukur. The defining bold form and subsequent prose now use one consistent order.

single_algebra_prefix_surfaces.note: Line 975 contains two surfaces, one governed by Sigma and one by Tau.

defining_form_evidence.assessment: The definition and all subsequent uses now share the natural prefix order.

post_correction_revalidation.ordered_xref_replay: 76 printed expressions to 80 atomic edges; pass

nondefects_confirmed: The source's partially defined functions and every dom f restriction remain deliberate and intact.
Juxtaposition hf is correctly understood and translated as composition, not multiplication.
The source's f times g remains pointwise multiplication, not a Cartesian product.
The ocint and ooint endpoint topology is preserved apart from the deliberate 121D(c) case-order correction.
The q<a unions in 121I retain the source's implicit rational index inherited from E_q.
The one-anchor G_mnk Cauchy coding in 121H is preserved as a valid equivalent criterion.
Fremlin's convention that N includes zero is not silently changed.
The inline hint in 121Ye is retained even though it is not encoded with the Hint macro.
